title: Shabbir Khuda Hafiz Shabbir Khuda Hafiz
body:
Shabbir Khuda Hafiz, Shabbir Khuda Hafiz
Aye Jaan O Dil E Hyder, Shabbir Khuda Hafiz
Aye Fatima Ke Dilbar, Shabbir Khuda Hafiz
1. Shabbir Tere Gham Ko Hum Kaise Bhulayenge
Karbal Ki Kahani Hum Duniya Ko Sunayenge
Taa Zeesth Tera Matam Hum Dil Se Manayenge
<<MINI>>
Sadma Hai Bahot Dil Par, Shabbir Khuda Hafiz
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Humshakl E Payamber Bhi Hote Hai Juda Hum Se
Abbas E Dilawar Bhi Hote Hai Juda Hum Se
Aur Qasim O Akber Bhi Hote Hai Juda Hum Se
<<MINI>>
Sadma Hai Bahot Dil Par, Shabbir Khuda Hafiz
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Phir Aab Ke Moharam Me Aayenge Mere Maula
Saath Apne Bahatar Ko Layenge Mere Maula
Mashghool E Buka Hum Ko Payenge Mere Maula
